name: List registry credentials
description: List registry credentials List registry credentials matching the provided filters. GET /v1/registrycredentials
context:
GET /v1/registrycredentials
List registry credentials matching the provided filters. If no filters are provided, returns all registry credentials you have permissions to view.
Optional: name (query) — Filter for the name of a credential; username (query) — Filter for the username of a credential; type (query) — Filter for the registry type for the credential; createdBefore (query) — Filter for services created before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); createdAfter (query) — Filter for services created after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); updatedBefore (query) — Filter for services updated before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); updatedAfter (query) — Filter for services updated after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); ownerId (query) — The ID of the workspaces to return resources for; cursor (query) — The position in the result list to start from when fetching paginated results. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).
